title: Rerun signed index v1
description: The bundle index.json (ADR 0024 with its amendment "Forward compatibility", docs/02-topo-format.md "Signed index"). The envelope is strict: format, seq, issued, topos, packages, nothing else; another envelope format is a new schema. Each entry's head is frozen for every entry format: format, id and, for a Topo, match.steam_appid keep their name, type, range and meaning; a newer entry format may add keys next to them. An entry of an entry format this version reads validates against topo.schema.json or package.schema.json (checked by the workbench tests); an entry of a newer format is only described by its head here, and the client sets it aside. The client checks the Ed25519 signature over the raw bytes before parsing.

seq.description: Monotonic; the client refuses one lower than the last it accepted, and the same number with other bytes.

topos.description: Released Topos (never status draft, never TODO), sorted by id without duplicates over every entry, known or newer.

format.description: The entry format: the lowest version of the entry language a client needs (frozen head key).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (frozen head key).

steam_appid.description: Frozen head key: 1 to 4294967295; 0 refuses the whole index.

packages.description: Released packages (never status draft, never TODO), sorted by id without duplicates over every entry, known or newer. A package head has no match.

format.description: The entry format: the lowest version of the entry language a client needs (frozen head key).

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (frozen head key).
